latest_release.name: v1.4.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Hint at a missing or invalid API key when a provider returns a 401 by @pushpak1300 in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1215
* Surface Anthropic web search results as citations by @sulimanbenhalim in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1214
* Add support for Gemini Decisions API by @crojasaragonez in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1231
* Update OpenAI transcription and image models by @pushpak1300 in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1217
* Forward attachment provider options to Anthropic text generation requests by @sulimanbenhalim in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1220
* Honor the Strict attribute on Anthropic tools by @sulimanbenhalim in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1219
* Decode structured output from a code fence with unpaired backticks by @andreilungeanu in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1216
* [1.x] Keep the text of every step in a prompted response by @medilies in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1222
* [1.x] Keep every tool call of a streamed Ollama reply by @EzzalddeenAli in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1218
* [1.x] Run catch callbacks when a broadcast agent job fails by @medilies in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1223
* [1.x] Allow overriding OpenAI image moderation through provider options by @efrain-salas in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1226
* [1.x] Report a sub-agent that throws as a failed tool call by @medilies in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1228
* Continue stored Gemini interactions with previous_interaction_id by @muhammetsafak in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1189
* [1.x] Let apps generate a conversation's title the way the package does by @medilies in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1229
* Reuse the Anthropic code execution container across tool loop steps by @sulimanbenhalim in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1213

## New Contributors
* @crojasaragonez made their first contribution in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1231
* @andreilungeanu made their first contribution in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1216
* @EzzalddeenAli made their first contribution in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1218
* @efrain-salas made their first contribution in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1226
* @muhammetsafak made their first contribution in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1189

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/laravel/ai/compare/v1.4.0...v1.4.1

detail.readme: ## Introduction The Laravel AI SDK provides a unified, expressive API for interacting with AI providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and more. With the AI SDK, you can build intelligent agents with tools and structured output, generate images, synthesize and transcribe audio, create vector embeddings, and much more — all using a consistent, Laravel-friendly interface. ## Documentation Documentation for the Laravel AI SDK can be found on the [Laravel website](https://laravel.com/docs/ai-sdk). ## Contributing Thank you for considering contributing to Laravel! The contribution guide can be found in the [Laravel documentation](https://laravel.com/docs/contributions). ## Code of Conduct In order to ensure that the Laravel community is welcoming to all, please review and abide by the [Code of Conduct](https://laravel.com/docs/contributions#code-of-conduct). ## Security Vulnerabilities Please review [our security policy](https://github.com/laravel/ai/security/policy) on how to report security vulnerabilities. ## License The Laravel AI SDK is open-sourced software licensed under the [MIT license](LICENSE.md).
